tail:
**Batch 58 authoring is complete.** I added two A-page proofs, the repeated-peeking example, and a counterexample to the plan’s event equality. The A theorem proves the crossing and supremum bounds separately; all four items have current `ready` Step 1 records.

The plan’s claim that the supremum event equals the finite-crossing event is false. The counterexample has supremum-event probability \(1/4\) and first-crossing probability \(0\), while satisfying the Ville bound. I recorded this and the planned MSF dependency mismatch in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-58.notes.md); the shared plan remains unchanged.

The A/B pages, [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-58.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-58.proof-contracts.json), and [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-58.coverage.json) are complete. I inspected the relevant full text in [Howard et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1808.03204) and [Wolpert’s lecture notes](https://www2.stat.duke.edu/courses/Fall10/sta205/lec/topics/mg.pdf); fetch checks passed for both.

The item levels are 0, 1, 2, 2. `validate-plan` passed page ordering with 10 redundant-prerequisite warnings, recorded in the notes.
